description: This Java source file defines an Android Service named AlarmService that manages background work such as scheduling notifications and executing a delayed task in a separate thread. It includes internal classes, lifecycle methods, and interaction with Android system components.

classes.name: AlarmService
classes.description: An Android Service that performs a background task for a fixed duration (15 seconds), displays notifications, and manages a worker thread to simulate background work.

classes.name: AlarmBinder
classes.description: An inner class extending Binder, providing a custom IPC binder for clients binding to the service.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the notification manager, shows a notification, and starts the background worker thread.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Cleans up the notification and shows a toast indicating service termination.

methods.name: onBind
methods.description: Returns the binder object for clients binding to the service.

methods.name: showNotification
methods.description: Creates and displays a persistent notification indicating the service is running, with an intent to launch AlarmActivity.
